teaser.en: People suck its small, sweet orange fruits, and its flexible twigs end up as baskets, traps, bows and walking sticks.
teaser.sw: Watu hufyonza matunda yake madogo matamu ya rangi ya chungwa, na vitawi vyake vinavyopindika huishia kuwa vikapu, mitego, pinde na fimbo za kutembelea.
teaser.dg: Atu nkufyondza matundage madide ga mtswano ga rangi ya chungbwa, na maphungoge ganayofyuka nkuhendwa vikapu, mihambo, maha na bakora.

summary.en: *Mngwene* is a liana of the coastal bush with clusters of small orange fruits and remarkably flexible branches. It feeds, builds and heals: the fruit is eaten, the twigs are woven and the roots are used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mngwene* ni mtambaa wa vichaka vya pwani wenye vishada vya matunda madogo ya rangi ya chungwa na matawi yanayopindika kwa ajabu. Hulisha, hujenga na huponya: tunda huliwa, vitawi husukwa na mizizi hutumika katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Mngwene* ni mmea unaokpwera wa weruni wa pwani, wenye mafungu ga matunda madide ga rangi ya chungbwa na panda zinazofyuka sana. Una fwaida kpwa chakurya, kudzenga na dawa: matunda nkuriwa, maphungo nkusukwa, na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mngwene* is a liana or scrambling shrub that can climb to about 5 m, with long, flexible branches that bend without breaking. The leaves are simple and fairly small.

Its pale yellow flowers have the thick, fleshy petals typical of the custard-apple family. They are followed by small clusters of orange fruit segments, each a little berry spreading from a common point like the fingers of a hand.
about.sw:
*Mngwene* ni mtambaa au kichaka kitambaacho kinachoweza kupanda hadi takriban m 5, chenye matawi marefu yanayopinda bila kuvunjika. Majani yake ni sahili na kwa kiasi ni madogo.

Maua yake ya manjano hafifu yana petali nene zenye nyama, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia ya mitopetope. Hufuatiwa na vishada vidogo vya vipande vya matunda ya rangi ya chungwa, kila kimoja kikiwa beri ndogo inayochipuka kutoka sehemu moja kama vidole vya mkono.
about.dg:
*Mngwene* ni mmea unaokpwera au chitsaka chinachokpwera, unaoweza kukpwera hadi mita 5 hivi, na panda mare zinazofyuka bila kuvundzika. Makodzage ni ga kawaida (chila kodza ni zima) na madide chiasi.

Maruwage ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu gana vipande viziho vya nyama, dza maruwa ga jamii ya *mbokwe*. Bada ya maruwa kunalunga mafungu madide ga matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa; chila tunda ni ridide, na gosi ganatuluka phatu phamwenga dza vyala vya mkpwono.

where.en: Look for *mngwene* in coastal bushland and along forest edges, climbing through other shrubs. The orange fruit clusters make it easiest to find when they ripen.
where.sw: Mtafute *mngwene* katika vichaka vya pwani na kando ya misitu, ukipanda juu ya vichaka vingine. Vishada vya matunda ya rangi ya chungwa huufanya kuwa rahisi zaidi kuupata yanapoiva.
where.dg: Hendza *mngwene* weruni wa pwani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, uchikpwera kahi ya vitsaka vyanjina. Mafungu ga matunda ga rangi ya chungbwa ganahenda uonekane rahisi ganaphoivwa.

uses.en:
The small fruits are sweet, and people suck the pulp from them. The flexible twigs are put to many uses: in house building, for weaving baskets and for making traps. The branches are also made into bows and walking sticks.

The roots are used in medicine.
uses.sw:
Matunda madogo ni matamu, na watu hufyonza nyama yake. Vitawi vinavyopindika hutumika kwa njia nyingi: katika ujenzi wa nyumba, kusuka vikapu na kutengeneza mitego. Matawi pia hutengenezwa pinde na fimbo za kutembelea.

Mizizi hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg:
Matunda madide ni ga mtswano, na atu nkufyondza nyama ya matunda higo. Maphungo ganayofyuka ganahumirwa kpwa kazi nyinji: kudzenga nyumba, kusuka vikapu na kuhenda mihambo. Panda nazo nkuhendwa maha na bakora.

Mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

culture.en: *Mngwene* is considered the 'female' or small *mngweni*, because of its small leaves. Its partner, *mngweni mkulu*, is the 'male' or large one.
culture.sw: *Mngwene* huhesabiwa kuwa *mngweni* 'jike' au mdogo, kwa sababu ya majani yake madogo. Mwenzake, *mngweni mkulu*, ndiye 'dume' au mkubwa.
culture.dg: *Mngwene* nkuonwa dza *mngweni* 'mchetu' au mdide, kpwa sababu makodzage ni madide. Myawe, *mngweni mkulu*, ni 'mlume' au mkulu.

names.en: Digo: *mngwene*, also *mngweni mdide* ('small *mngweni*'). The names *mumbweni* and *mudzala* are also recorded for the Digo in another source. Swahili: *mgweni*, *mwacha* and *mganda simba*. Duruma: *mdzala*. Giriama: *murori*. Note that the headword is spelled both *mngwene* and *mngweni* in the records. Scientists call it *Uvaria acuminata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mngwene*, pia *mngweni mdide* ('*mngweni* mdogo'). Majina *mumbweni* na *mudzala* pia yamerekodiwa kwa Kidigo katika chanzo kingine. Kiswahili: *mgweni*, *mwacha* na *mganda simba*. Kiduruma: *mdzala*. Kigiriama: *murori*. Ifahamike kuwa jina kuu huandikwa *mngwene* na pia *mngweni* katika kumbukumbu. Wanasayansi huuita *Uvaria acuminata*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mngwene*, piya *mngweni mdide* ('*mngweni* mdide'). Chitabu chanjina chinaandika piya madzina *mumbweni* na *mudzala* kpwa Chidigo. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mgweni*, *mwacha* na *mganda simba*. Kpwa Chiduruma ni *mdzala*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *murori*. Manya kukala dzina hiri rinaandikpwa *mngwene* na *mngweni* kpwenye maandiko. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Uvaria acuminata*.
